description: This file defines an abstract React component class 'AbstractComponent' that manages application events and observers, providing a base class for other components to extend in a web application context. It integrates MobX for reactive state management and interacts with application lifecycle events.

classes.name: AbstractComponent
classes.description: An abstract React component class that manages application event observers and lifecycle, meant to be extended by concrete components.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up application event observers when the component mounts.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up event observers and resets references to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Handles cleanup before the component unmounts.

methods.name: viewControllerManager
methods.description: Getter that returns the ViewControllerManager instance from the application.

methods.name: autorun
methods.description: Sets up a reactive autorun using MobX.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for application lifecycle events, calling corresponding handlers.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Optional override for handling generic application events.

methods.name: onAppStart
methods.description: Optional override for handling app start event.

methods.name: onLocalDataLoaded
methods.description: Optional override for handling local data loaded event.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Optional override for handling app launched event.

methods.name: onAppKeyChange
methods.description: Optional override for handling app key change event.

methods.name: onAppIncrementalSync
methods.description: Optional override for handling incremental sync event.
